summary: Agentic SDLC Automation for Test Execution Evidence Management
description: As a QA Engineer, I want an Agentic SDLC workflow that retrieves Jira stories through Atlassian MCP and automatically generates SDLC artifacts for test execution evidence management, So that requirements, architecture, design review, implementation plan, verification reports and pull request documentation remain synchronized and traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: Jira story is retrieved through Atlassian MCP.
All artifacts are stored under docs/<story-id>/.
Approval gates are enforced between SDLC stages.
GitHub MCP validates pull request readiness.
